# FlightPlan Ventures

> FlightPlan Ventures is a CPG venture studio based in Dallas, Texas. It invests in early-stage consumer brands and builds them alongside founders with a full operating team covering brand, product, technology, growth, operations and finance. It can stand a brand up in 120 days and stays on as the ongoing growth partner. It runs its own SPVs and helps brands raise capital.

## Key facts
- Type: CPG venture studio, growth investor and operating partner
- Location: Dallas, TX, working with brands across the US
- Categories: food and beverage, health and wellness, beauty and personal care, home and lifestyle, pet, commerce tech
- Capacity: four to six new brands a quarter
- Engagement: majority-ownership builds, an accelerator track for brands with traction, and brands the studio originates itself
- Contact: hello@flightplan.ventures (founders), lp@flightplan.ventures (investors)

## Pages
- [Home](https://flightplan.ventures/): how the studio works, the portfolio, and founder and LP applications
- [Cameron Gawley](https://flightplan.ventures/cameron-gawley): co-founder and managing partner; founder of GLiTCH Candy; former CEO and co-founder of the DTC agency BuzzShift (sold 2016, bought back 2017, sold to private equity 2021)
- [Bryan DeLuca](https://flightplan.ventures/bryan-deluca): co-founder and partner; founder of Foot Cardigan, featured on Shark Tank; scaled licensed product programs to $15M a year
